top_3_arguments: Price has already run ahead of the sell-side: current_price $415.63 sits 5.7% ABOVE the 12-month consensus PT of $393.16 (analyst_consensus_web) and 4.0% above the 3-month avg PT $395.95. Citi's catalyst-watch reiterate carries only a $400 PT. Buying a breakout above watch_level $415.63 is paying for upside the street has not yet underwritten — with roc_21d = 26.94% and roc_10d = 8.97% already in the tape, the asymmetry skews toward sell-the-news mean-reversion back to the $393–$400 PT band, not fresh leg-up.

Binary earnings risk inside the trade window: earnings.days_until_next = 13, confirmed by earnings_context_web (next_earnings_date = 2026-05-20). The setup is breakout continuation but the holder will face the print before any structural target is reached. The 2026-05-03 SimplyWall.st piece flags 'mixed execution trends' against 'higher earnings hopes,' i.e., the bar is elevated. The stop structure (watch_level $415.63 → invalidation_level $410, ~1.4% risk) does NOT compensate for a gap-down on guide; this is event-asymmetric risk the bull thesis ignores.

Insider distribution + technical exhaustion converge: 2026-05-05 SimplyWall.st (recent_news_7d, sentiment neutral) documents CEO Vincent Roche selling ~$3.98M of stock and explicitly notes 'insider sales near all-time highs' as a flag. Pair that with extension that is itself a bear case: rsi_14 = 74.71, rsi_21 = 77.86, z_score_50 = 2.07 (>2 sigma), price 20.1% above sma_50 and 47.18% above sma_200, bollinger pct_b = 0.8979, AND daily volume.obv.trend = 'down' with diverging_from_price = true. OBV bearish divergence into a CEO sell at the highs is the signature of late-stage momentum, not the start of a fresh leg.
